nsw.name: New South Wales
nsw.researchStatus: Scoped 2 November review: Walcha councillor Adam Iuston resigned effective 23 October; Council confirms a by-election, with dates awaiting NSWEC. Coffs Harbour nomination lodgement opened 2 November at 9 am AEDT, verified 3 November. Hunters Hill retains its published 2 November opening date without an independently verified opening hour. Both close 11 November at noon AEDT; no accepted candidates are inferred. Election review 1 November: Council's 20 October election notice dates Marc Lane's resignation to 14 October; 15 October is the earlier notice publication date, not the resignation date. Hunters Hill's confirmed 12 December by-election timetable is unchanged. The 31 October review of David Harris remains: he will not recontest Wyong at the 13 March 2027 state election, but remains MP and continues ministerial duties until then; no current vacancy. Cobar and Coffs Harbour retain their 30 October election review; Parliament composition retains its 23 October review and no full federal roster audit is claimed.

government.note: Labor is one seat short of a Legislative Assembly majority and governs with crossbench support.
